why: Every note stands in the inside margin beside its verse. PTXprint moves crowded notes up and down within their page but cannot carry them to the next, so where a page's notes overrun its margin, the tallest of them are set below the text, as footnotes with callers, each keyed by the note, with the passage it relieves. The placements are made for the published typeface, Valkyrie, and tolerated in the Utopia fallback, where the check that every note stands in its margin passes too.
